fullContentHtml:
UPESSC PRT Assistant Teacher Online Form 2026 (12405 Posts) - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC) has released the notification for the post of Assistant Teacher (Primary Teacher PRT). This recruitment has been issued for 12405 posts. Online applying process for UPESSC PRT Assistant Teacher Recruitment 2026 has started from 16 September 2026 & the candidates can apply till 15 October 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for UPESSC PRT Assistant Teacher Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 16 September 2026
  • Last Date : 15 October 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 15 October 2026
  • Correction Date : 19 October 2026
  • Exam Date : 03-04 December 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 1000/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 500/-
  • PH : Rs. 300/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
